description: This file defines the DesCrypt utility class for performing 3DES (Triple DES) encryption and decryption operations, including key generation, encryption, decryption, and related helper methods. It uses Java's javax.crypto and java.security APIs, and includes references to cryptographic specifications, encoding, and exception handling.

classes.name: DesCrypt
classes.description: Utility class for DESede (3DES) encryption, decryption, key generation, and related cryptographic operations.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Generates a new Triple DES (DESede) key.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts input bytes using a provided key; prepends IV for decryption.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data bytes that were encrypted with a specific key, extracting the IV from the payload.

methods.name: getDesKey
methods.description: Constructs a SecretKey object from a raw byte array representing a DESede key.

methods.name: getCipher
methods.description: Creates and initializes a Cipher instance for DESede encryption/decryption with CBC mode and PKCS#5 padding.
